|translation='''Title:''' It Can Wait.

'''Card text:'''
Play just after the opponent deploys a card. Spend 3 Force to return that card to the opponent's hand. Force spent to deploy it remains spent. On the opponent's next turn, that card must be deployed to the same location unless impossible. Force is not spent for that deployment.

'''Lore:'''
Captain Solo. I should tell you... no, it can wait.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Game text matches original printed English and uses ロケーション; it lacks the later Immediate Effect exception.
